name: filagora/filagora-forums
description: Forums for Filagora: forum groups, forums, threads and posts, visibility and posting rules, and moderation, as a Filament plugin.

suggest.filagora/filagora-entitlements: Answers the access checks from entitlement grants and lets the forum screens pick entitlement keys. Without it, bind Filagora\Core\Contracts\AccessChecker.
suggest.filagora/filagora-search: Adds the forum search (threads, filters, visibility) with a choice of engine: Meilisearch, or the database.
suggest.intervention/image: Makes thumbnails of uploaded images. Without it files are stored without one.
